- [LLET.10.4] **RHS-only visibility.** `let` is
  syntactically in the RHS block and semantically
  visible only there: later `let`s' right-hand
  sides, action arguments, emit / publish slot
  values, string interpolation. Not visible in
  pattern `where` clauses (those are in the LHS
  block and match only on pattern bindings) and
  not visible across rules. Syntactic and semantic
  position now match.
